title: 第2174章 决意东行第2173章 跨界之邀
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
他的语气依然轻松，像是在谈论一件无关紧要的商品。
但他的瞳孔，已经锁定在玄无道身上。
玄无道没有说话。
他只是握紧了手中的暗沉长刀。
在张远的感知中，玄无道握刀的手指在收拢的过程中，指尖与刀柄接触的位置上，有极其细微的银白色光芒渗入刀柄之中。
那些光芒，沿着刀柄内部的纹理向刀身延伸，像是正在唤醒沉睡在刀身中的某种东西。
整柄刀在他握紧的过程中，发出了一声极低极低的嗡鸣。
那嗡鸣不像金属的震颤，更像是一头埋藏在深土中的远古凶兽，在被唤醒时发出的第一声喘息。
然后他动了。
他的动作没有任何预兆。
没有蓄力，没有起手式，没有气息提升的过程。
他就那么握着刀，向前迈了一步。
然后在迈出那一步的瞬间，他的身影消失了。
不是速度快到肉眼无法捕捉的那种消失。
他确实消失了，像一滴水融入大海一样，从所有人的感知中消失了。
在铁屠的感知中，那个刚刚还站在那里的灰袍青年，就像从来没有存在过一样。
他的目光无法锁定，他的气息无法捕捉，他的存在感完全归零。
在黑甲中年的感知中，玄无道也消失了。
但那是一种不同的消失方式。
在铁屠眼中，玄无道是消失了。

在黑甲中年眼中，玄无道是融入了周围的法则之中。
他的气息不再是单独的一缕，而是均匀地分布在周围的空间中，与空气中流动的风、与岩石中残留的热量、与光线在地面上的投影融为一体。
他不是消失，他是把自己变成了环境的一部分。
然后刀锋从他的左侧虚空浮现。
无声无息。
没有破风声，没有刀气外泄，甚至没有杀意。
就像一轮月亮从云层后面露出来那样自然。
那柄暗沉的长刀从虚空中刺出，刀尖直指黑甲中年的左肋。
那个位置，刚好是他甲胄覆盖范围的最薄弱的接缝处，是肩胛甲与胸甲之间的一道极细的缝隙。
那道缝隙在甲胄正常穿戴时是被完全覆盖的。
但黑甲中年刚才收回手掌时，左臂有一个极轻微的旋转动作，那道旋转让肩胛甲的边缘向上偏移了不到一根发丝的宽度，露出了一道几乎可以忽略不计的缝隙。
玄无道抓住了这道缝隙。
他的刀尖，精准地指向那道缝隙的中心。
黑甲中年的瞳孔猛地收缩！
那瞳孔中的暗金色光芒，在刀锋浮现的瞬间亮了一下。
他来不及转身。
来不及发力。
但他的身体，在他意识的反应之前，已经做出了回应。
他的左臂手肘，以一种几乎不可能的角度向内弯曲，肘尖精准地撞向那柄无声浮现的刀锋侧面！
那个动作的速度快到了极致，快到铁屠的眼睛根本捕捉不到任何动作。

他只能看到黑甲中年的左臂，位置在瞬间发生了变化，从自然下垂变成了横挡的姿态。
肘部与刀锋碰撞的瞬间，没有发出金属撞击的巨响。
发出一声沉闷得像是两座山峰撞在一起的声响。
“咚！”
content_en:
His tone was still relaxed, as if he was talking about an insignificant product.
But his pupils were already locked on Xuan Wudao.
Xuan Wudao said nothing.
He just clenched the dark long knife in his hand.
In Zhang Yuan's perception, when Xuan Wudao's fingers holding the knife were tightening, at the point where the fingertips were in contact with the handle of the knife, there was an extremely fine silver-white light seeping into the handle.
Those rays of light extend along the inner texture of the handle to the blade, as if they are awakening something sleeping in the blade.
The entire knife made a very low hum as he tightened his grip.
The buzzing sound was not like the vibration of metal, but more like the first gasp of an ancient ferocious beast buried in the deep soil when it was awakened.
Then he moved.
There was no warning in his movements.
There is no accumulation of energy, no starting position, and no process of breath improvement.
He just held the knife and took a step forward.
Then the moment he took that step, his figure disappeared.
It's not the kind of thing that disappears so fast that it can't be caught by the naked eye.
He did disappear, disappearing from all perception like a drop of water merging into the ocean.
In Tie Tu's perception, the young man in gray robe who was standing there just now was as if he had never existed.
His gaze could not be locked, his breath could not be captured, and his sense of existence was completely reduced to zero.
In the perception of middle-aged Heijia, Xuan Wudao also disappeared.
But that's a different way of disappearing.
In Tie Tu's eyes, Xuan Wudao had disappeared.
In the eyes of the middle-aged Heijia, Xuan Wudao is integrated into the surrounding laws.
His breath is no longer a single wisp, but evenly distributed in the surrounding space, blending with the wind flowing in the air, the heat remaining in the rocks, and the projection of light on the ground.
He doesn't disappear, he becomes part of the environment.
Then the blade emerged from the void on his left side.
Silent and silent.
There was no sound of breaking the wind, no sword energy leaking out, and even no killing intent.
It's as natural as a moon emerging from behind the clouds.
The dark long knife stabbed out from the void, the tip pointed directly at the left rib of the black-armored middle-aged man.
That position happened to be the weakest seam in the coverage of his armor, a very thin gap between the shoulder blades and the breastplate.
That gap is completely covered when the armor is worn normally.
But when the black-armored middle-aged man retracted his palm, his left arm made a very slight rotation. The rotation moved the edge of the shoulder blade upward by less than a hair's width, revealing an almost negligible gap.
Xuan Wudao seized this gap.
The tip of his knife pointed accurately at the center of the gap.
The pupils of the middle-aged man in black armor shrank suddenly!
The dark golden light in the pupils lit up the moment the blade emerged.
He didn't have time to turn around.
There was no time to exert force.
But his body responded before his consciousness could.
The elbow of his left arm was bent inward at an almost impossible angle, and the tip of the elbow accurately hit the side of the blade that emerged silently!
The speed of that movement was extremely fast, so fast that Tie Tu's eyes could not catch any movement at all.
He could only see the left arm of the middle-aged man in black armor. The position changed in an instant, from hanging down naturally to a horizontal position.
The moment the elbow collided with the blade, there was no loud sound of metal collision.
There was a dull sound like two mountain peaks colliding together.
"Boom!"
